seo.title: Barbershop Christmas Opening Hours: Do Late Nights Pay?
seo.description: Should your barbershop open late in December? A simple extra-hour test, 2026 bank holiday dates, staff rules, and how to fill January before it arrives.

media.anchor: # The Extra Hour Test: Planning a Barbershop's December Without Fooling Yourself

media.anchor: In general: **break-even cuts = extra cost of opening the hour ÷ contribution per genuinely additional cut**.
media.alt: With £15 in extra hourly costs and £19 contribution per genuinely additional cut: one cut gives £4, one and a half £13.50, and two £23; displaced bookings are not extra cuts
